dogecoin.text: So what does that mean? Well, memecoins play different roles in crypto. The @dogecoin family (DOGE, SHIB, etc.) attracts newbies who buy through exchanges and don't use wallets. They’re dipping their toes in crypto, mixing as investors and speculators.

Onchain metrics like wallet numbers don’t paint the full picture. Top wallets own about 65% of @dogecoin and similar for @Shibtoken, with 18 exchange wallets holding 41.6%. Despite 3M Dogecoin wallets, estimates suggest 15M+ global holders. https://t.co/PSkP0FF2MN

Among the top 20 coins, four— @dogecoin, @Shibtoken, @RealFlokiInu, and BabyDoge—are Doge or Doge derivatives, making up 67% of the total market cap. Most activity isn't onchain, with holders using centralised exchanges, making it tough to measure actual user numbers. https://t.co/oXuURGuRIN
